Title: Varian Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Abathur ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the cooldown for Toxic Nest to be reset whenever Symbiote expired.

=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Health lost due to activating Last Laugh will no longer be restored when Medivh's Force of Will with the Reabsorption Talent expires.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could enable Medivh to cast Abilities while in Raven Form on Warhead Junction.

=== Heroes: Samuro ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Mirror Images can no longer launch Nukes on Warhead Junction after learning Illusion Master.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Seeker in the Dark Talent will no longer allow Zeratul to Blink to unintended areas of terrain or inside of Structures.

Heroes: Abathur: • Fixed an issue that caused the cooldown for Toxic Nest to be reset whenever Symbiote expired.
Heroes: Alarak: • Health lost due to activating Last Laugh will no longer be restored when Medivh's Force of Will with the Reabsorption Talent expires.
Heroes: Medivh: • Fixed an issue that could enable Medivh to cast Abilities while in Raven Form on Warhead Junction.
Heroes: Samuro: • Mirror Images can no longer launch Nukes on Warhead Junction after learning Illusion Master.
Heroes: Zeratul: • The Seeker in the Dark Talent will no longer allow Zeratul to Blink to unintended areas of terrain or inside of Structures.
